title: The Quiet Lantern
author: Kestrel Reyes
blurb: Oscar Whitlock, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
